source_request: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보 데이터에 반영해줘. 시각 의미 데이터의 대체 표현을 추가/보강하는 작업을 중심으로 진행하고 후보 데이터에도 잘 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: The requester asks independent arms to author random complex concepts and use the supplied image to test actual visible realization. This arm independently chooses an intimate botanical salon portrait at the threshold between a living night greenhouse and its dry specimen archive. The assigned broad stage is coordinator-owned. The lowering action, begonia, garnet/ivory palette, hime cut, cat-ear headband, petticoat, and lace-up bodice are agent-owned choices, not requester definitions. The central experience is a warm human presence interrupting a cool cataloguing space; attraction is a subtle supporting quality at the saved sensual=1, with fetish=0 and surreal=0. The face uses only observable reference appearance; fictional adult age, hair, wardrobe, body, role, and expression are invented. WHO: a visibly poised fictional adult amid her own styling. WHERE: life and preservation share one threshold. HOW: a nearby eye-level viewer receives her calm camera acknowledgment. WHY NOW: the pot is caught just before reaching the low trolley shelf. A still pressed leaf gives the living transfer its immediate visible counterpart. These artistic choices remain editable on open dimensions.
subject: A fictional adult woman guided only by the supplied portrait's visible facial appearance.
setting: Night greenhouse adjoining a specimen archive, with glass-front storage shelves and a wheeled specimen trolley.
event: One photographic moment of visibly realized styling; independently chosen action is lowering a potted flowering begonia toward a low trolley shelf.
visual_priorities: Her face remains the first point of warmth within the cool archive and green plant edges.
The hime cut separates short blunt cheek sections from the longer rear layer, with a physically readable cat-ear headband on the crown.
The garnet bodice exposes the real eyelet-and-crossed-cord closure while the ivory petticoat visibly sits beneath the outer skirt.
The living begonia approaches the trolley beside a dry pressed leaf, joining greenhouse and archive in one readable moment.
baseline_prompt_en: A complex editorial photograph catches a single photographic moment in a night greenhouse adjoining a specimen archive. A fictional adult woman dressed for an after-hours botanical salon lowers a small flowering begonia toward a wheeled specimen trolley; the supplied portrait guides her visible facial appearance, including softly rounded facial contours, dark rounded almond eyes, a softly shaped nose, and full bowed lips. Her own invented styling has a hime cut: straight black hair with blunt jaw-length sidelocks ending sharply beside both cheeks, a straight eyebrow-level fringe, and a distinct longer back layer falling below her shoulders. A slim black headband arcs across her crown and carries two triangular felt cat ears as a wearable accessory. She wears a garnet satin dress with a square neckline. Two opposed vertical rows of metal eyelets frame the bodice opening, a black cord threads repeatedly across the opening in clear X-shaped crossings and ends in a small tied bow. The knee-length outer skirt flares over a separate gathered ivory petticoat; the petticoat's layered ruffled hem visibly extends below the satin hem and supports its rounded volume. Her left palm supports the pot's saucer while her right fingers steady the terracotta side; the pot stays beside her left thigh, just above the trolley's low shelf, leaving the bodice front readable. Her feet rest on the level aisle, her torso stays comfortably upright, and she turns her face toward the camera with a quiet, inviting expression. A dry pressed leaf on an archival sheet lies on the trolley near the living plant. Glass-front storage shelves recede behind her, roof trusses frame the dark night sky, and broad greenhouse leaves occupy the far edge. A warm task lamp gives the face and satin gentle lustre against cool teal archive light. An eye-level, head-to-toe vertical composition keeps her facial appearance, separated hair lengths, headband construction, lacing, and both skirt layers readable, with natural photographic texture and restrained background detail.
